title: P15.9-A1 R3: no raw owner filter before strict read; stale review pins no longer count as pending
description: R3 closure on PR #91 (BASE e24e334); R1+R2 preserved. R3-F1 raw owner filter bypass: businessCompany previously filtered owner_authority_id on tolerant objectives.list() rows BEFORE canonical validation — an owner/digest-tampered row was silently omitted and the company read returned successfully with missing data. Now every objective row in the business is strict-read via objectives.get FIRST (canonical row + digest + anchor proof; a tampered row fails the whole read closed), and only proven rows are owner-filtered. R3-F2 stale owner inbox: owner_action_required and targets_met_pending now require the latest review's authority pins (objective_version + objective_terms_version + objective_digest, pinned at review commit) to equal the CURRENT strict-read objective — a TARGET_MET_CANDIDATE minted before an owner amend() is retained in history verbatim but no longer counts as a live pending approval in cockpit lifecycle, company latest_review, or the exact pending aggregate. Tests 25/25: adversarial owner-tamper detected (2-objective case), KPI MET → CANDIDATE → owner amend → pending=false everywhere while the review stays in history, all R1/R2 negatives preserved. No CEO/Router/Executor/KPI-writer/Telegram changes; no auth expansion; no UI/A2. No merge/deploy.
